description: This PHP source file defines the 'Authorize' class within the OpenCart admin startup controller namespace. The class handles authorization logic such as token validation, redirecting to dashboards, and managing two-factor authentication (2fa). The primary method 'index' manages routing, token validation, and access control based on configuration settings.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Handles authorization, token validation, and 2FA management for admin startup in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that processes the route, checks authorization tokens, manages 2FA, and decides on redirects based on current auth state and configuration.
